Buildings bulletin 2022-012
ISSUED: September 6, 2022



   Construction Codes Requirements
   HIGH-PRESSURE BOILER SUPERVISION
   BACKGROUND
   • Section AC §28-413 requires a high-pressure
     boiler be operated under the direct and
     continuing supervision and in the presence of a
     high-pressure boiler operating engineer

   • Exceptions to the requirement of a licensed
     High-Pressure Boiler Operating Engineer are
     provided where certain conditions are met.




   HIGHLIGHTS
   Clarification on when the requirement of a High-Pressure Boiler Engineer operating engineer license is
   required:
   1. What is a stand-alone boiler for the purpose of applying AC §28-413.
   2. How to apply exceptions to AC §28-413 in multiple stand-alone high-pressure boilers installations.


   Read the full Bulletin 2022-012 for more details on the requirements.

   Send questions to constructioncodes@buildings.nyc.gov.
